title: The Headbutt Nobody Saw
setup: July 9, 2006, World Cup final in Berlin. Zidane scored a penalty early and Materazzi headed the equalizer, so the match is in extra time. With ten minutes left, Zinedine Zidane headbutts Marco Materazzi, who goes down and stays down. Referee Horacio Elizondo and both linesmen did not see it.
question: What does Elizondo do?
options: Play on, since no official saw it.
Red card for Zidane after the fourth official reports it.
ruling: Fourth official Luis Medina Cantalejo told Elizondo over the headset, "A really violent headbutt by Zidane on Materazzi, right in the chest." Elizondo first waited to see if Materazzi would get up, then stopped play and, after consulting linesman Dario Garcia, sent Zidane off with a red card.
rulebookNote: The source describes the referee acting on the fourth official's report of a violent act he had not seen himself. It does not say how the final ended.
